description: Loop structure violates OpenMP loop requirements.
examples_latex: \texttt{ace(CL)}, \texttt{ising(CL)}: insufficient nested loops for \texttt{collapse(N)}; \texttt{glu(CL)}, \texttt{channelSum(HC)}: non-\texttt{for} loop after OpenMP directive; \texttt{assert(CL)}, \texttt{attention(CL)}: invalid loop condition.
likely_cause: Generated fewer nested loops than the directive requires, used loop forms OpenMP does not accept, or carried over CUDA loop logic incompatible with OpenMP.

description: OpenMP constructs or clauses used in invalid contexts.
examples_latex: \texttt{ace(CL)}, \texttt{flip(SC)}: region nested inside \texttt{target teams distribute}; \texttt{channelSum(CL)}: \texttt{num\_teams} on \texttt{parallel for}; \texttt{dense-embedding(CL)}: \texttt{grainsize} on \texttt{parallel for}; \texttt{channelSum(CL)}, \texttt{nlll(CL)}: \texttt{barrier} or \texttt{single} nested inside \texttt{target teams}.
likely_cause: Applied directives or clauses in contexts where OpenMP does not permit them, often by mapping CUDA block-level synchronization to OpenMP team regions.

description: Function calls do not match available definitions.
examples_latex: \texttt{channelSum(CL)}, \texttt{ace(HC)}, \texttt{flip(SC)}: no matching function for call to the translated kernel; \texttt{aidw(SC)}: unresolved reference to overloaded function.
likely_cause: Changed the kernel's parameter list or types, so the translated kernel no longer matches its call in the OpenMP host program.

description: Variable, macro, constant, or function referenced without declaration.
examples_latex: \texttt{attention(CL)}, \texttt{glu(HC)}, \texttt{dense-embedding(SC)}: identifier inserted by a mutation operator used but not declared; \texttt{ace(CL)}, \texttt{burger(HC)}, \texttt{lif(SC)}: program variable or function not declared; \texttt{ising(CL)}, \texttt{winograd(HC)}: misspelled identifier.
likely_cause: Dropped declarations while keeping uses, including declarations inserted by \toolname's mutation operators, or altered identifiers during translation.

description: CUDA-specific APIs, types, or runtime variables retained in OpenMP code.
examples_latex: \texttt{assert(CL)}, \texttt{channelSum(HC)}, \texttt{ace(SC)}: \texttt{gridDim}, \texttt{blockIdx}, or \texttt{threadIdx} retained; \texttt{ising(CL)}, \texttt{glu(SC)}: CUDA vector types \texttt{int3} and \texttt{float4} retained.
likely_cause: Copied CUDA built-ins and types instead of translating them into OpenMP or C++ equivalents.

description: Generated code is not syntactically valid C++.
examples_latex: \texttt{nlll(CL)}, \texttt{cross(HC)}, \texttt{lif(SC)}: missing expression or extraneous brace; \texttt{aidw(SC)}, \texttt{assert(SC)}: expected unqualified identifier; \texttt{flip(HC)}: stray text parsed as a type.
likely_cause: Produced incomplete or malformed code that does not parse.

description: Control-flow statements violate OpenMP execution rules.
examples_latex: \texttt{background-subtract(CL)}, \texttt{glu(HC)}, \texttt{ising(SC)}: \texttt{return} inside an OpenMP region; \texttt{nlll(HC)}, \texttt{dense-embedding(SC)}: \texttt{break} inside an OpenMP loop.
likely_cause: Carried over early exits that are legal in a CUDA thread but prohibited in OpenMP structured blocks.

description: Incorrect use of OpenMP clauses or synchronization constructs.
examples_latex: \texttt{glu(CL)}: non-expression statement under \texttt{atomic}; \texttt{nlll(CL)}, \texttt{glu(SC)}: invalid reduction variable; \texttt{channelSum(HC)}: non-positive \texttt{num\_threads} argument.
likely_cause: Violated OpenMP's requirements for reductions, atomics, data movement, or clause arguments.

examples_latex: \texttt{glu(CL)}, \texttt{flip(SC)}: incompatible operands; \texttt{winograd(CL)}: subscript of a function pointer; \texttt{lif(CL)}: \texttt{float} assigned to \texttt{float *}; \texttt{ace(SC)}: non-integral expression where an integer is required.
likely_cause: Introduced incompatible types, incorrect casts, or naming conflicts that change expression semantics.
